# Sortorium - Agentic Browsing Guide

## Overview
Sortorium is an all-in-one ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) platform designed for retail businesses. It provides tools for POS (Point of Sale), HRM (Human Resource Management), Inventory Management, Sales, Purchases, Analytics, and CMS.

## Navigation
- [Home](/)
- [Blog](/blog)
- [Demo Request](/demo)
- [Contact](/contact)
- [Sign In](/signin)
- [Sign Up](/signup)

## Interactive Elements
The site uses standard HTML forms for all data entry (e.g., Demo Request on /demo). All form inputs are associated with `<label>` tags via the `id` and `htmlFor` attributes to ensure high accessibility for automated agents.

## Actions
- To request a demo, agents should navigate to `/demo`, fill out the form (First Name, Last Name, Work Email, Phone Number, Company Size), and click the "Request Demo" button.
- To read blog content, navigate to `/blog` and follow the article links.

## Architecture
The site is built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS. It is fully static and optimized for Agentic Browsing, ensuring minimal Layout Shifts (CLS) and a stable Accessibility Tree.
